licenses.text:
Diodati Bibbia 1885, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/ita1885/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/ita1885/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in Italian, translated by Giovanni Diodati in 1641 and revised in 1821
> Public Domain
> Language: Italiano (Italian)
> Contributor: United Bible Societies
> Diodati Bibbia 1885
> 2025-05-03

What was found:
Text: Giovanni Diodati's Bible (Diodati died 1649), revised 1821, in an 1885 edition with section headings and cross-references.

Why it stays out: missing fact: who revised eBible.org's New Testament text, and when (it differs from the 1885 Rome edition it names, for example John 3:2, 3:4, 3:17, 3:20-21); also the life dates of the 1819/1821 reviser (named G.B. Rolandi by secondary sources).

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=ita1885), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/ita1885/copyright.htm), https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bibbia_Diodati.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)
